mainEntity.name: Has Japanese Ramen Simulator been released?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Wild Dog released the Windows Steam game in Early Access on October 9, 2026. The latest numerical patch verified here is v0.1.48.17626.
Yes. The official Steam listing supports single-player and NPC part-time staff. The launch patch documents dish-clearing staff; it does not establish full kitchen automation.
Steam advertises up to six. Wild Dog’s October 9 press-release headline says up to ten, with six recommended, while its body repeats six. This wiki has not tested the larger limit.

mainEntity.name: Are there exact recipes for every bowl?

acceptedAnswer.text: The verified sources identify menu categories and Tantanmen broth options, but do not publish a complete quantity or scoring formula. Our cooking guides show confirmed rules and mark the missing details.

mainEntity.name: Is this an official game website?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This is an independent fan reference. We link official announcements and distinguish confirmed mechanics from suggested kitchen workflows.

mainEntity.name: Does The Perfect Pour require a perfect beer ratio?

acceptedAnswer.text: The published Steam requirement is to serve beer once. It does not specify a perfect foam ratio.

mainEntity.name: Do the level achievements confirm ingredient unlocks?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The achievements name shop-level milestones; ingredient purchase and order thresholds need their own source.
